column2: The facing of one's own work can be given by another, at least in part.
A giving is free when it is not owed to the one who receives it.
One can turn toward a giving before what it gives has arrived.
Turning toward grace is something the one who repents does, even if what grace gives is not their own doing.
Repentance can be under way before it contains sin's contrary.
Turning toward a gift and receiving it are distinct.
A facing received as freely given points to a giver.
Facing oneself as a whole is possible though not every part of oneself can be seen.
